row.title: A wall-clock probe turned every PR red
row.body: CLOCK-TEST-1 (2026-11-25, Session: session_0156nqDvJ5oNPSCVZzS8cYKL): seedlife.probe read the wall clock while its test fixture is pinned to 2026-11-21, so the 48 h live window expired on 11-23 and test_seedlife failed in every checks run. That blocked the lane from merging anything. The probe now takes now= and the test passes NOW. Also the org-profile probe grepped a phrase the profile dropped; it now matches the heading and closes its own issue on pass.
